Also: https://www.yorkshirepost.co.uk/health/andy-burnham-to-push-for-faster-social-care-reform-from-baroness-casey-8773440
(Search snippet content)

Andy Burnham used his first speech as Labour leader (Friday 17 July 2026) to place social care reform at the heart of his agenda.

DIRECT QUOTE — Andy Burnham (first speech as Labour leader): pledged to "have the courage to fix the big things that politics has neglected, like social care, and have the conviction to go out there together and argue for our plans."

DIRECT QUOTE — Andy Burnham (earlier in July 2026): "It is urgent, the need to fix social care, and I personally would look at all of the implications of that in relation to inheritance tax and care charges and everything."

DIRECT QUOTE — Andy Burnham: promised to "expend quite a lot of political capital" on social care.

- Burnham was a principal architect of the 2010 white paper "Building the National Care Service".
- Burnham is reported to want to bring forward some of the longer-term recommendations of the Casey Commission by the end of this year; Baroness Casey has indicated she is happy to move faster.
- Councils face a reported £7bn black hole in social care funding.
